name: Restart notice
packageArguments: Optional. {"Message":"<notice text, no double quotes>","SnoozeMinutes":"60","PromptMinutes":"10","CountdownMinutes":"15","ReportOnly":"false"}. ReportOnly "true" only detects and writes the device field relianSessionState (userPresent, reason, users, sessions, pending, lastBoot, build, snooze, timestamp); no notice, no restart. Base64 of the JSON goes in the runner's -PackageArguments. Without it the defaults above apply. Optional MaintenanceRestart "true" (default "false") includes valid PendingFileRenameOperations pairs as a restart reason. It defers when setup/servicing processes, active Setup flags, owned/legacy native markers or uncertain safety probes are present. Checks run before notices and immediately before parent-owned shutdown, including no-user, Restart now and timeout paths. In this opt-in mode the themed PSADT countdown uses an ordinary installation prompt with a Restart now button and timed expiry; it cannot reboot independently. Snooze and user-presence rules remain unchanged. No MoSetup/legacy running-marker override, cleanup, servicing, marker removal or automatic upgrade.
